rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that something is soaking wet.

example.english: After the heavy rain, our clothes were soaking wet.
example.traditional: 落完場大雨，我哋件衫濕晒。
example.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 gin6 saam1 sap1 saai3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that something is wet right through or saturated.

example.english: The blanket was soaking wet all the way through after the rain got in.
example.traditional: 雨水浸入嚟，張被濕透喇。
example.jyutping: jyu5 seoi2 zam3 jap6 lai4 zoeng1 bei6 sap1 tau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the thing is visibly dripping wet, rather than merely saturated.

example.english: They came out of the pool soaking wet and dripping.
example.traditional: 佢由水塘上水，成身濕淋淋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 seoi2 tong4 soeng5 seoi2 seng4 san1 sap1 lam4 lam4
